scientific_question: Can a deployment-visible, geometry-only choice of five or seven cameras remove the frozen sparse-view reconstruction tail without changing the inverse solver?
role: result-blind controlled virtual-BOST sensor-selection diagnostic; not a learned initializer, not a real experiment, and not a resource result
physical_hypothesis: The five-camera failure may be caused by the fixed camera subset rather than missing reconstruction capacity; selecting a subset that maximizes low-frequency gradient observability should improve the sparse-view tail if that explanation is correct.

mechanism_boundary.distinct_from_v159_v168: v159-v162 changed global quadratic priors and v163-v168 changed temporal transports; v169 changes only which reported cameras are active and keeps the frozen H1 and CGLS solvers unchanged
mechanism_boundary.no_truth_or_observation_selection: camera selection uses only reported calibration geometry and a frozen analytic low-frequency DCT sentinel
mechanism_boundary.single_primary: one lexicographic rank/log-pseudodeterminant/minimum-eigenvalue/trace objective; no alternate subset objective or post-result tie-break
mechanism_boundary.not_training: zero trainable parameters and no fitted state

new_data_boundary.senior_instruction: generate two-component 2D displacement fields from the executable 3D density field and camera positions
new_data_boundary.historical_pairing_status: the old paired experimental 2D data is unavailable
new_data_boundary.claim_boundary: all observations are generated by the frozen straight-ray virtual proxy; real_bost remains false

frozen_predecessor.closed_family: fixed four-envelope boundary-tapered stationary local divergence-free vortex

source_semantics.density_output: first TorchScript output is density; require finite values only and apply no clipping or offset
source_semantics.synthetic_pairing: camera-field pairing and observations are generated by code; no true experimental pairing is inferred
source_semantics.source: direct clarification from the supervising senior inherited from v168

inputs.models: same nine CPU TorchScript models sealed by v157-v168
inputs.calibrations: same thirteen nine-camera JSON files sealed by v157-v168

camera_selection.canonical_order: ascending exact finite float tuple; geometry keys must be unique
camera_selection.candidate_roster: all combinations of the nine canonical cameras for each requested cardinality
camera_selection.sentinel_modes: all zero-mean DCT modes with each axis index in [0,3]
camera_selection.whitening: divide each sentinel column by the square root of the frozen median-one physical H1 penalty
camera_selection.tie_break: first lexicographic canonical subset on exact objective equality
camera_selection.permutation_contract: reordering input camera records yields the same canonical geometry sequence and selected physical cameras
camera_selection.variable_cardinality: the same frozen objective natively selects 5, 7, and 9 cameras

representation.field_subspace: zero-mean orthonormal DCT 16x8x8 excluding the constant coefficient
representation.primary: selected camera subset followed by unchanged isotropic H1-Tikhonov
representation.control: the same selected camera subset followed by unchanged DCT1024-CGLS K16

regularization.selection_per_sample: none; one subset per calibration and cardinality, shared by all models and times
regularization.forbidden_variants: no alternate score, sentinel size, eigen cutoff, H1 multiplier, CGLS iteration, per-sample selector, fallback, or learned sensor policy

metrics: p50/p90-higher/worst by time, arm, and camera count
selected canonical subset and observability score

cost_accounting.geometry_setup: 1023 exact nine-camera A-equivalent basis projections per calibration, reused by every subset, model, and time
cost_accounting.camera_selection_after_geometry_cache: zero exact A/A-transpose calls; dense 63-mode score only
cost_accounting.primary_online_after_geometry_cache: one exact reduced A-transpose equivalent and one exact reduced A equivalent
cost_accounting.resource_claim: forbidden until a later fresh-process wall and whole-pipeline RSS gate

independent_recomputation.basis: analytic cosine products rather than scipy idctn construction
independent_recomputation.selection: independent canonicalization, subset enumeration, scipy symmetric eigensolver, score, and exact subset decision
independent_recomputation.solver: independent generalized eigendecomposition and CG recurrence

decision_order: Any input, canonicalization, selection, operator, basis, solver, accounting, or independent-recomputation failure makes v169 inconclusive.
Only the frozen low-frequency H1-whitened geometry score is the primary camera selector.
Pass requires all twelve time-by-camera strata, nine-camera no-harm versus selected-subset CGLS, and strict t=0.75 five-camera gradient improvement versus frozen H1.
A valid failure closes the hypothesis that this exact geometry-only camera subset selection repairs the sparse-view tail; it does not close all sensor design or the C route.
A valid pass establishes only controlled virtual-proxy sensor-design headroom and does not authorize a learned model, GPU, real-BOST claim, or resource claim.
